question: 7 males A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Only four males are to the left of A. B is the immediate neighbour of A and C. D is third to the left of E. F is not the immediate neighbour of E. What is the position of D from the left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven males A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing north.

Only four males are to the left of A

B is the immediate neighbour of A and C.

D is third to the left of E

F is not the immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee042288534e388aab4f6e71c5b5c79e2d68ca29606eb1cb3fd32b7b0d38da42.png] 

So, D is at position 1

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
